大卫与班会的计划(David and the the class meeting: 一篇关于社交生活的A2短文:大卫与艾米的经历和小计划。
David is reading a book about art. David hopes to visit Sydney one day. The game corner is one of the best places in the city. What's more, the newly married couple moved into a small apartment.
Last Saturday, David and Amy went to the game corner. The weather was snowy that day. Amy is interested in dancing. The poor bugger lost his wallet on the bus.
David likes snowy days best. Both of them like rice and juice. There are always many people at the class meeting. Best of all, he poured his heart out on the phone.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the game corner by bike. David usually has rice for breakfast. David thinks art is interesting but a little difficult.
